title: Before It Was 'Us'
description: Back then, we only existed in the background of loud celebrations and crowded halls. I’d see you across the room at family functions, tucked away between the rituals and the relatives. We were just two people following traditions, never realizing we were about to start one of our own. Looking back, those moments were like the prologue to a book I hadn't opened yet. We’d exchange a few words or a smile while the chaos of the function swirled around us, but even then, there was a quiet connection that the rest of the room couldn't hear. Little did I know that the girl I kept bumping into at weddings and festivals would eventually become the person I’d want to walk through life with.
